Dimaag ki khai sabse ujjwal ummeedo ko nigal ti hai.

Khud ko jaanana hi devataon par vijay hai.
Pathar mat bano, paani bano.

Teekha dimaag ek ajit champion hai.
Dil tark ki koi sarhad nahi jaanta.
Hum hawa ke peeche bhagte hain aur sirf dhool paate hain.

Teekhi dhaar dushman aur dost dono ko kaat ti hai.

Teekha dimaag sabse ghane andhere ko cheer deta hai.
Aatma ka samudra vichar ke aakash ko darshata hai.
Ek chalak ankh marna chhapi kitaab se zyada kehta hai.

Bharosa ek baar banta hai aur hamesha ke liye kho jaata hai.
